{"consolidated_memory":"ANALYTICS/DASHBOARDS/FUNNEL.PY - Missing Step Issues (3 Separate Incidents)

All three incidents manifested the same symptom in the funnel report: a stage with zero users appearing between two populated stages. All occurred in analytics/dashboards/funnel.py on the analytics side. Reproduction for all three: build the funnel for the two week window. Testing framework: tests/analytics/test_funnel.py. Stack: Python.

INCIDENT 1 - [2026-03-08, c004-e0]
Trigger: Appeared only on the staging read replica
Root cause: Two writes were never wrapped in a transaction
Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #3355 on branch fix/missing-step-1)
Measured outcome: Cold start dropped 8 percent, to 283 ms

INCIDENT 2 - [2026-04-10, c004-e2]
Trigger: Appeared only for records carrying non-ASCII names
Root cause: A listener was registered but never removed
Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #4564 on branch fix/missing-step-3)
Measured outcome: Throughput rose 56 percent, to 940 requests per second

INCIDENT 3 - [2026-06-15, c004-e5]
Trigger: Appeared only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root cause: An error was swallowed by a bare except clause
Fix: Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate (PR #6756 on branch fix/missing-step-6)
Measured outcome: Memory settled at 830 MB instead of climbing past 2 GB"}
